race.comment: Scratchings change the look of this one this morning. BRINDAVAN (4) is going as good as ever and returns to QLD after giving a bold sight in the G3 Five Diamonds. Drawn a dream for Maloney who takes back over with a strong association. Will get a great look with a couple of his biggest dangers coming away. FABULANTES (15) is yet to strike this campaign but is knocking on the door and gets his chance to put it all together right down in the weights. Watch for him rattling through late. FUKUBANA (5) possesses a strong turn of foot and can cause a scare if they overdo it in front as well. Drae can pop a question or two of CUNNAMULLA FELLA (6) but he continues to race well.
